notes.title: V1.5.2 - Prism Orb Tweaks
notes.notes:
Just a small change with this version, mainly regarding the Prism Orb weapon.

Previously it would rebound off bosses as if it had struck a regular enemy or wall, which could cause two problems that made it less than idea for general gameplay:

1) It could get "stuck" inside bosses if they teleported or entered the stage into an Orb. The Orb would then repeatedly deal damage, quickly dealing far more damage than intended in some circumstances.

2) If it rebounded off a boss and was sent careening around the screen, another Orb was unable to be fired by the player until the first one found a way to disappear, making it difficult to use effectively against the single-target boss enemies outside of the situations where it was getting stuck inside them.

As a result, the following changes have been made:

Prism Orbs no longer bounce off boss enemies, instantly dealing their damage and disappearing when striking them.
The Prism Orb weapon will then instantly begin recharging for another shot after striking the boss.

It is hoped that this change will make the player a more active part of the fight and less liable to be at the whims of complete random chance when using the Prism Orb weapon.

This change may be reverted or altered if it ends up being less fun than the original behaviour, of course!

Thank you, everyone, for enjoying DAR!

Also, the Codex medal was not being correctly granted. It should not be granted as intended!

Thank you for the reports that allowed these to be swiftly fixed!
Let me know if anything else remains an issue!

notes.title: V1.3.2 - Additional Features!
notes.notes:
Here's another small update for D.A.R!

An option has been added to enable the "Combo Klaxon" - if it's hard to keep track of when your combo is about to expire in the heat of battle, this option will add a small icon near your ship and play warning sound when you've only got a few moments left to renew your combo. Hopefully this helps make keeping track of combos easier for those going for the biggest combo possible!

In addition, the End of Run screen now displays a Run Time, regardless of the mode being played.
This is the actual time spent playing during that run, inclusive of menus, not just gameplay time.
This was a requested feature to help people better keep track of the time spent playing the game, or how long an individual run took.

These are only very minor features, but perhaps they'll be appreciated by a small handful of people - so enjoy!

Thanks again!

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
It's been a little while but that's right! Another major version!

So, what's new to be found in 1.3.0?


Two new unlockable modes!

REMIX - a more difficult version of Standard featuring new enemy selections on every planet and altered, more challenging, boss fights!
Expect to be fighting tricky foes from the very start - not even Minibosses will pull punches in REMIX, so consider this one for the experts out there!
You'll want to use your Gems at every opportunity, or you might not be able to keep up with the difficulty of this mode!

REMIX Rush - Want to challenge yourself against all the new boss fights? Use this mode to practice all the new battles, or push yourself to defeat them all as quickly as you can!
Like Boss Rush, this is a time-based mode, so you'll really need to know your stuff if you want to land at the top of the leaderboards!

If you've already defeated the DAR leader, you'll find these modes are unlocked immediately!

If you haven't, you'll need to clear Standard mode again, or for the first time to unlock them!


A new character:

Saga and the Dovetail

A mercenary with a checkered past, Saga will do anything if the price is right.
Bringing along his signature craft, the Dovetail, he's hoping to bag a big bounty by taking out the belligerent DAR invaders!

The Dovetail is a tricky beast to pilot - it features a unique shielding system that enables it to absorb enemy shots, so long as its shielding matches their energy signature.

By pressing the Special Attack button you can change the type of shot it will absorb - if the Dovetail's colour matches the colour of the enemy's attack, it'll absorb it, extending your combo and slightly recharging your own weapons!

It can take some practice to master, but you're practically invincible if you can use it well!


In addition, this update changes a things:

It is not possible to more than 100 achievements in a single game on Steam, so several easier or more redundant Achievements have been removed with this update and replaced with new ones to account for the additional content available in 1.3.0.

The following Achievements have been removed:
Combo Starter
Multiplier Multiplied
Speed-ish Clear

They have been replaced with:
Payday
Super Speed Clear REMIX
REMIX Ruler


And for those playing in Japanese, you might find that the font used to display Kanji-based text has changed.
This is to overcome an issue with playing the game on Steamdeck in Japanese. Proton incompatibilities were causing text to become invisible when played in Japanese on Steamdeck with the game's chosen font and this was the only solution I could find!
Please forgive me if it looks a little less visually polished as a result! If you know any Japanese pixel-style fonts with readable glyph sizes smaller than 10 by 12 pixels, please let me know!


Thank you to everyone playing DAR!
If any unexpected bugs appear as a result of this update, please leave a comment here or contact me via email or Twitter!

notes.title: V1.2.4 - Japanese Text Fixes and Tutorial Tweaks!
notes.notes:
Wow, the new year is so close! I hope everyone is enjoying themselves!

Just some super tiny changes this time:

1) Some Japanese language text has been modified for clarity

2) The tutorial was interacting strangely with the Prism Orb and Ray Gun weapon, so a bit of the code handling it has been tweaked. If anything breaks as a result of this, please let me know!

That's all!

notes.title: V1.2.3 - A balance patch!?
notes.notes:
Turns out the Prism Orb was way more powerful than I had expected in endless runs, as it racked up strength in an almost exponential fashion!

Like, it would bring the game close to crashing from the sheer number of orbs you could get into play...

The weapon has been hit with DAR's first nerf: You can now only have as many Orbs in play as you have maximum Stock!

If you play to the weapons intended strength, keeping orbs in play by bouncing them to defeat multiple enemies with a single shot, rather than just randomly firing orbs everywhere and hoping to score kills, it's still a very powerful and capable weapon when powered up, but not the end-all automatic screen clear it could become on endless runs prior to this change!

My apologies for the sudden change!

notes.title: V1.2.2 - Achievement Fix
notes.notes:
Just a quick fix!

The "Unfathomable Power" Achievement was not correctly being awarded when the requisite number of enemies were defeated.
I messed up and borked the Steam API call for that Achievement, so the game was instead trying to re-unlock the "Unstoppable Force" Achievement.

This is now fixed!

notes.title: V1.2.1 - Some quick fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Hope you're enjoying the new content in the V1.2.0 update!

I'm rolling out a few quick fixes for some small bugs that appear in unusual circumstances:

1) If your movement speed was really high (in the 500% or greater area), and you also had the Turtle item, you'd sometimes experience a "brake failure" and your vehicle would swerve all over the place uncontrollably. This was hilarious, but unintentional and has now been fixed.

2) The game was still randomly declaring Boss Rush times as new records when they weren't. While I can't fault the game for its positivity and enthusiasm, I can fault it for being wrong. This has hopefully been fixed!

If anything else comes up, let me know!

Have fun, everyone!

notes.title: The V1.2.0 Content Update is here!
notes.notes:
Happy holidays, everyone!

Here's the second big content update for DAR!

Three new characters have been added:

[b]Pocomagi[/b], a mysterious, magical tanuki who can imbue his Rocket attacks with elemental fire!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/03f770b5f441002799b8e52020ddfc617a416476.png[/img]
His craft, the [b]Tanu Tank[/b], is a heavily armed and lumbering vehicle, slower than every other ship.
It's capable of dealing a ton of damage with its higher than normal base Shot Power and multi-hitting Rocket weapon!

[b]Primrose[/b], court witch of a distant world armed with magical spheres called Prism Orbs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/3f092d089c85b4e0c1d769e268f98fdc3035d580.png[/img]
Her craft, the [b]Properose[/b], is less of a machine and more of a magical construct!
It can't be loaded with any weapon other than the Prism Orb, so you'll need to master the use of this weapon to succeed!

And [b]D-06[/b], a serious cybernetic warrior who comes armed with the deadly-precise Ray Gun weapon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/6cbc2c8e19d974816d72e68aa6d59547bc1522c4.png[/img]
Her craft, the [b]Q-Beige[/b], is extremely fast but extremely fragile.
It comes pre-loaded with the Ray Gun weapon, but can be swapped to a small variety of other weapons should the need arise. Be especially careful of enemy shots when using it!


And three new weapons to try out:

[b]The SprayStorm[/b], a weapon that rapidly fires an absolutely huge amount of extremely weak shots! Great for when accuracy comes second to keeping your combo going!

[b]The Prism Orb[/b], a weapon that fires bouncing spheres that rebound off enemies and projectiles, slowly gaining speed. You can aim them before firing and bounce them back into play to keep damaging enemies - just don't let them hit the ground or they'll dissipate!

[b]The Ray Gun[/b], a precise laser-targeted weapon that needs to lock on to enemies before it can be fired. Locking on to the same enemy several times before firing increases the damage the weapon deals! Individual lock-ons will reset your combo timer, so play patiently for maximum results!

Alongside this, there are [b]34 more achievements[/b] to hunt down, so prepare for some challenges!

I hope everyone enjoys the new content in DAR!
As always, if any bugs or problems appear, please leave a comment here or send me a message via email or twitter and I'll do my best to fix what I can!

notes.title: V1.1.9 - Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Hey again! Something super small with this update, perhaps the smallest thing so far:

Following a fix made to prevent the game being too stingy with upgrades under certain circumstances, it was sometimes being too [i]generous[/i] when playing on practice mode in other circumstances.

This busted fix should now be fixed.

Please let me know if see any unusual behaviour come from this particular patch!

The next content patch is coming very soon!

notes.title: V1.1.8 - Just a tiny change!
notes.notes:
This is an extremely minor update, and the following has been changed:

-Swapping from the Inverse Gun was not properly awarding score multiplier as it should. This has been fixed!

Coming up soon is the V1.2.0 update, featuring things such as additional characters and weapons to try!
Development is progressing smoothly, so it's likely to be ready to roll in about a week's time - look forward to it!

notes.title: V1.1.7 - Available Now!
notes.notes:
One bug fix and two display issues have been implemented with this version:

Bug fix: 

-If you pressed confirm to select an upgrade item on the exact frame menu movement on the upgrade menu became possible, you might be unable to select any items at all. The game will now do a failsafe check to prevent you from being unable to obtain the correct number of items.

Display fixes: 

-The item that extends the duration of the combo meter actually increases the meter by 25%, not the displayed 50% - this was due to a change in the specification of the item during development that I just forgot to reflect in the description. My bad!

-If you reached the selection limit for an item then scrolled the cursor over the option to delete that item, the game might erroneously and temporarily display that you had hit the limit for other items. This was purely a display issue and is now fixed.

That's it for now!
I'm working on the next content patch right now, with some new characters to play as!
Expect it in a few weeks if all goes well!

notes.title: V1.1.6 - Boss Rush Touch-ups
notes.notes:
Another small patch, polishing the Boss Rush mode a little more!

Bosses will now appear more quickly when a planet is selected, starting from V1.1.6.
They were appearing quite slowly on V1.1.5, and it was impacting potential scoring opportunities.
Their appearance speed has been made closer to V1.1.4 and the regular wave theme should no longer be heard for a moment before they attack!

In addition, the game was sometimes erroneously declaring a failed run as a "New Best!" even though it most certainly wasn't! This has also been fixed!

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: V1.1.5 - just a small patch!
notes.notes:
Two tiny additional fixes:

1) Prevented the Sacrifice and One Hit Wonder items from always appearing on Zone 5, 10 and 15 during Boss Rush mode. Zone 21 is always available in Boss Rush and this overlap in conditions could cause all sorts of bugs in the item select menu if certain actions were taken.

2) Sometimes, in very specific circumstances, bunker spikes would fail to disappear between zones and leave a phantom spike floating in mid-air. They should now correctly be removed in those situations.

That's all this time! Sorry for all the minor bugfixes! Just trying to prevent potential frustrations when running into extremely situational bugs.

One more thing: If you're playing on Steamdeck in Japanese, apparently the item description box was failing to appear. A potential fix for this issue is included in this build. Please let me know if you experience any issues with the item description box when playing in Japanese.

Thanks!

notes.title: V1.1.4 has been released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Hope you are all having fun!

A few major bug fixes in this version courtesy of an in-depth report from TANUKI AOGON!

Issues fixed:

1) The limit warning for the Bunker Up item was not triggering properly. This has been fixed.

2) Bunkers sometimes shifted upwards at the beginning of a zone, likely due to them being accidentally shot by the player during the screen transition. Bunkers are now unable to be damaged until the screen transition has reached a certain point that renders them visible on-screen.

3) Enemies are now delayed from beginning battle during the GEARED UP screen transition. This prevents them getting a jump on you unfairly later in the game.

4) The erroneous interaction between Spikey Bunkers and bosses that could cause them to become invincible in extremely specific circumstances is resolved, bosses will now break spikes and take damage. In addition, damage dealt by bunkers and spikes will now reset the combo countdown.

5) An bug involving Spikey Bunkers has also been fixed - they would cause an error when combined with the "One-Way Bunker" item that would cause bunkers to stop interacting with bullets entirely.

In addition, a myriad of text has been revised in the Japanese language setting to be clearer or fix display bugs!
Thanks again, TANUKI AOGON!

Since there were some considerable changes made in this version, please report any bugs you see either here on the patch page, or over here:
https://x.com/DeliciouSoft

With the launch sale over, I'd like to thank everyone who grabbed DAR!
I'll be aiming to have an additional content update available by the holiday season - keep an eye out!

notes.title: D.A.R V1.1.3 is now available!
notes.notes:
This version fixes a bug that was preventing Boss Rush scores from being submitted if you were playing without upgrades turned on.

A silly typo was causing the Steam API calls to send and request data to and from the wrong place. This should now be resolved!

In addition, the credits have been updated to reflect the recent assistance of youtuber TANUKI AOGON in refining the Japanese translation of the game!

notes.title: V1.1.2
notes.notes:
For clarity's sake, attempts that end in failure while playing in Boss Rush mode will now display "DNF" as your time.
Internally, the time is still set to "9999999" frames when you quit or are destroyed, but it will no longer be user-visible!

notes.title: V1.1.1
notes.notes:
Additional minor text fix for Japanese language option.
(Sorry, nothing exciting!)

notes.title: D.A.R Version 1.1.0 is now available!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for your support!
I'm overwhelmed by the kindness and generosity of so many players who decided to purchase D.A.R!
Out of gratitude I've implemented a bunch of new features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/337adbd75e287b564d9a681a0f742d1b9f98cfe5.png[/img]

D.A.R Version 1.1.0 is now available!

Meet two new characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/fb3544e5213f7626387d1fe1280df4e9996383a8.png[/img]
Lowe, piloting his ship, the Retro Blast

Lowe has travelled from the distant 8080 galaxy to help fight off the Deadly Alien Rogues!
He might be old, and his ship made from dated tech, but he can still blast invaders like the best of them!

Lowe starts with the Classic Gun and cannot swap to any other weapon! 
The lineup of items available when playing as Lowe are different to other characters. Some items are more common, some items less common, and others aren't available at all!
I hope he gives people a new way to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/84992349f91f539e3034d485f6531035d21f1a84.png[/img]
Ajitama, piloting the Pico-Pico Pod

Bringing his musical spaceship, he'll blast the Deadly Alien Rogues with waves of groovy tunes!
He might be small, but you shouldn't doubt his talents for a second!

Ajitama starts with the Shotgun weapon - though it fires some distinctly different projectiles when he's using it.
Offsetting the great starting offensive abilities, he's among the more fragile characters - so be careful!


In addition, those two characters, plus the original three, all have access to a brand new mode:
Boss Rush!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45275905/4a5f9a39f0a4b7e20da394cb0e4d4a38c3e09fb0.png[/img]

This is a mode where you do nothing but fight all of the games bosses in a row, with the goal being to clear them all out as fast as possible!
Items available in this mode are different to the others - you'll not find any score or combo increasing items, for example!

In order to place on the new Boss Rush leaderboard you'll need to defeat all the bosses - if your ship is destroyed during a run, you'll default to the worst score possible!
Successful attempts will have their times, measured in frames, added to the new leaderboard.
Just know that you're not timed when the game is paused, or you're in menus, so you are free to take your time when choosing items and really consider your character builds.

Outside of the new content, there's a few other changes in V1.1.0

-In-game Highscores now show the top 5 players in each mode, making it more useful to those who don't want to manually check the Steam Leaderboards outside of the game.
-The Japanese translation has several improvements in places such as the story screens and item descriptions. I hope those playing D.A.R in Japanese have a more enjoyable time with these changes!

I hope everyone enjoys the new content! Thank you all so much!

If you run into any bugs or weirdness, please report it by leaving a comment on this announcement - thank you!

notes.title: Minor fix: Pause screen stat display
notes.notes:
I just noticed that if you pause the game prior to beginning actual gameplay, your stat display would erroneously report most of your abilities as 0% of their base level.
This was because they only got calculated once gameplay begun, and has now been rectified.
Stats should no longer display as 0% when pausing the game prior to gameplay.

notes.title: Minor Update - Remapped Pause Button
notes.notes:
Hey there! Hope everyone is having fun!

Just a minor update - pause has been remapped from the ~ key to Escape, to avoid an issue where players using regional keyboards in which the ~ key doesn't exist were unable to pause the game!

There are no other gameplay changes here, but I've begun listing version numbers on the title screen for the sake of convenience.

notes.title: Minor text fix
notes.notes:
As per the report from Salvor in the community page - the text for a [i]really important[/i] mechanic was loading in the opposite language than intended .

This has now been rectified! 
Thank you for the report, Salvor!

notes.title: Japanese Text Hotfix
notes.notes:
I noticed that Japanese text displayed strangely or blurry on a lot of machines - turns out I'd forgot to include some critical fonts in the initial release build!

Sorry about that - it should be drastically improved now!

notes.title: Deadly Alien Rogues - The Invasion Has Begun!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Pilots!

Deadly Alien Rogues is now available to play!

I hope everyone enjoys the game!

The global leaderboards are now public, too - consider these a "Season Zero" of the game!
You can navigate to the leaderboards by clicking on "View My Achievements" from your Steam Library, then clicking the "Leaderboards" option at the top right!

You can also view your score [i]position[/i] in game from the high-scores page!
I'd like to implement viewing additional scores in-game at some stage, too - but this is the first time I've ever worked with the Steam Leaderboard API!

On the topic of some stage - 
If additional content gets added or crazy bug appears that changes scoring enough, the leaderboards might be reset in the future (But any top-scorers will be preserved in a public post for posterity - don't worry!)

And one last thing for now: if you run into any interesting bugs please feel free to report things either via email or here and I'll take a look into it!

Have fun, everyone!

notes.title: Provisional Support for Japanese Language Added
notes.notes:
To enable Japanese players that are unfamiliar with English to enjoy D.A.R, a preliminary translation has been completed. 

Unfortunately, due to restricted resources and abilities, it is primarily a machine translation! Because the game's text in Japanese is likely full of errors, I'd like to request that people report any glaring issues that lead to parts of the game being completely incomprehensible. 

I will do my best to implement requested changes to enable Japanese players to enjoy the game, to the best of my ability! 
I beg for your forgiveness in advance!! 

If you are comfortable with English, playing without Japanese enabled is likely to be a more comfortable experience.
